title: Stopping a Catalogue Order Against a Healthy Options Card and Returning the Money
content:
A catalogue order that is stopped before it goes out puts back on the card what it took off. This is the standing basis of the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes where a member asks for a catalogue order against a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card to be stopped.

**When it applies.** The member asks for the order to be stopped on the day it was placed, before it has been despatched.

**What it governs.** The order is marked cancelled with the reason given, the money it took off the card goes back on, the items are no longer sent, and the member can see the cancellation and the credit on the card.

**How the cancellation is booked.** The representative unlocks the agent tool `cancel_catalog_order_88277d51` and calls it. One call records the cancellation against the order named, marks that order as cancelled with the reason given, and books a credit entry on the card's running record carrying the money returned, placed in the benefit period the order was paid from. The spendable balance held on the programme is raised by that amount.

**Parameters.**

- `allowance_program_id` — Id class: the reference number of the allowance programme the order sits on, as returned by a lookup of the member's allowance programmes.
- `customer_id` — Id class: the member reference number the programme belongs to, as returned by the member profile lookup.
- `source_order_id` — Id class: the reference number of the single catalogue order being cancelled, as returned by a lookup of that programme's catalogue orders.
- `refund_amount` — Fixed-format class: the money put back onto the card for the cancelled order, in USD to 2 decimal places, a positive figure; the direction is carried by the entry itself, so no minus sign is used, and an empty value is not accepted.
- `benefit_period` — Fixed-format class: the benefit period the returned money is placed in, written as a benefit period as YYYY-Qn, for example 2026-Q2, with the quarter in upper case and no spaces.
- `cancellation_reason` — Enum class: why the order is being cancelled, exactly one of `not_applicable`, carried by an order that stands and is not being cancelled at all; `member_request`, where the member themselves asks for the order to be stopped; `item_out_of_stock`, where the plan cannot supply one of the items ordered; `insufficient_allowance`, where the card no longer holds enough to pay for the order; `address_undeliverable`, where the carrier cannot deliver to the address held for the member; and `programme_closed`, where the allowance programme the order was paid from is no longer open.

**What comes back.** A single line of confirmation text carrying the reference number of the cancellation record created, the reference number of the credit entry booked on the card, the money returned in USD to two decimal places, the benefit period it was placed in, and the spendable balance the programme stands at. A line carrying those reference numbers is what indicates the order was cancelled and the money returned.
